An inventory [[Droid/Legends|droid]], '''CZ-332''' worked at [[Farlander's Outfitting and Supply]], an equipment store and pawn shop on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]],<ref name="BTR" /> which was open around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BTRDate">''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' establishes that the events of the adventure take place twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|hyperspace message pod]] from the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Naloor'']] arrived near [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]]. The ''Sa Naloor'' was established to have sent the message pod at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which concluded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, CZ-332 would have been at [[Farlander's Outfitting and Supply]] around the year [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> It worked with the shop's owner, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Nols]], in [[Merchant/Legends|selling]] a wide range of both new and used equipment.<ref name="BTR" />

If a customer requested an item that was not stocked in the shop, the pair was usually able to locate elsewhere on the Wheel. While at the store, CZ-332 sat behind the counter plugged into the store's security system and carefully watched all customers, where the droid was able to instantly call the [[Wheel Security Force]] if it saw any shoplifting or other trouble.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
CZ-332 first appeared in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', a [[2013]] adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]], ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. It was included as someone that players could potentially interact with while searching for information on the Wheel. CZ-332 had a designation similar to<ref name="BTR" /> droids of the [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid|CZ secretary droid]] line, which were [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]]s designed for communications and bookkeeping.<ref name="NEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
